description: This file contains functions for exporting data from a Mattermost server, including users, channels, posts, emojis, and files, into a structured format, possibly for backup or migration purposes. It handles creating ZIP archives, generating URLs for exports, and managing file I/O.

methods.name: BulkExport
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive export of server data including users, channels, posts, emojis, and files, optionally creating a ZIP archive, and updating job progress.

methods.name: exportAttachments
methods.description: Exports file attachments, handling errors and progress updates.

methods.name: exportWriteLine
methods.description: Serializes a line of data to JSON and writes it to the provided writer.

methods.name: exportVersion
methods.description: Exports version information of the server.

methods.name: exportRolesAndSchemes
methods.description: Exports roles, schemes, and associated data.

methods.name: exportRoles
methods.description: Exports roles that are not part of schemes.

methods.name: exportSchemes
methods.description: Exports role schemes for a given scope.

methods.name: exportAllTeams
methods.description: Exports all teams and returns a map of team names.

methods.name: exportAllChannels
methods.description: Exports all channels associated with given teams.

methods.name: exportAllUsers
methods.description: Exports all users, including preferences, profile images, team and channel memberships, and custom statuses.

methods.name: exportAllBots
methods.description: Exports all bot users and their profile images.

methods.name: exportAllPosts
methods.description: Exports posts, including replies, reactions, attachments, and thread followers.

methods.name: exportFile
methods.description: Exports a file either into a ZIP archive or to a directory.

methods.name: GeneratePresignURLForExport
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for downloading an export file.
